question: PEP 830: Add timestamps to exceptions and tracebacks

options.title: Add a timestamp to exceptions and tracebacks at the time of instantiation.
options.summary: This aligns with the current handling of exceptions and tracebacks and avoids unnecessary complexity.

evidence.quote:
This PEP adds an optional timestamp to all exceptions that records when the exception was instantiated with no observable overhead. When enabled via environment variable or command-line flag, formatted tracebacks display this timestamp alongside the exception message.

If you’ve ever debugged a production Python system involving many forms of concurrency and wished you had more information about what happened when, this PEP may be for you.
evidence.author: gpshead
